entities.name: "The Grey Raven"
entities.summary:
*A Pact sniper who kills from impossible distances. Nobody knows who.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unknown | Ranger | Unknown | Unknown |

**Looks.** Nobody knows. A grey feather is sometimes found near the bodies.

**Manner.** Unknown.

**Who they are**

- A sniper of the [Shadow Pact](/player/e/FAC-004), in [The Eternal Veil](/player/e/REG-005). Nobody knows who.

**What people say**

- The Grey Raven kills from impossible distances.
- Look up, not around.

entities.name: Aarakocra
entities.summary:
*Feathered folk of the high passes, who see the world from above and find it smaller than everyone says.*

Aarakocra nest in the high passes above the Green Expanse and in the storm-cliffs of the [Fractured Nexus](/player/e/REG-004), where the Consortium pays them well to carry messages through weather no airship would try. They have little patience for borders, which they can't see from the air.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) they roost on the cliffs of the [Eastern Mountains](/player/e/REG-302) and the northern ice. Some families say the spore-storms gave them their wings; others say they always had them, and the [Bloom](/player/e/COS-301) only made more of them.

**Strengths and flaws.** Unmatched scouts and messengers. Restless, and uneasy under a roof.

**Culture.** Clan nests, sky-songs, and a long memory for which way the wind blew on important days.

**Common names.** Aeka, Kirru, Pell, Quill, Sarrik, Tiriel, Ulla, Zephi

**At the table.** Use the aarakocra rules.

entities.name: Aasimar
entities.summary:
*People with a little of the divine in them, who glow when they're angry and are never quite sure why.*

Aasimar are born to ordinary families, most often in the [Radiant Ascendancy](/player/e/REG-002), and the [Celestial Order](/player/e/FAC-001) claims every one it can find. Many serve gladly. Many run. Since the Cycle broke, aasimar have been born who say they dream of a light that isn't [Solenne](/player/e/DEI-901)'s.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) aasimar are rare and quietly watched. [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302) records every one in its rolls, and someone else is said to keep a list of its own.

**Strengths and flaws.** Healers and fighters with a light of their own. Hunted for it, and held to standards nobody else is.

**Culture.** No culture of their own; they take their family's. Most carry a guide they hear in dreams.

**Common names.** Aurel, Cassiel, Ilyra, Lumen, Orlaith, Seren, Theron, Veyra

**At the table.** Use the aasimar rules.

entities.name: Aedrin "the Cinderfather"
entities.summary:
*A tiefling king who burned his own people, cursed to burn forever.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tiefling | Mage | He/him | A kingdom nobody remembers the name of |

**Looks.** A tiefling king in a melted crown, his body always smouldering, ash falling from him like snow.

**Manner.** Grave, courtly and eaten up with guilt.

**Who they are**

- A figure of the [Ashen Covenant](/player/e/CLT-001).
- Once a king. Burned his own people.

**What people say**

- Aedrin is cursed to burn and never die.
- He prays to be forgiven, and something answers.

entities.name: Aerie-Speaker Kree
entities.summary:
*The aarakocra speaker of the eastern peaks, who watches the [Ascendancy](/player/e/FAC-305) from above.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Aarakocra | Monk | They/them | The eastern peaks |

**Looks.** A grey-feathered aarakocra with a white crest and a necklace of mountain stones.

**Manner.** Serene, blunt and fond of long silences.

**Who they are**

- Speaker for the aarakocra of the eastern peaks, in [The Eastern Mountains](/player/e/REG-302).

**What people say**

- The aarakocra see every column the Ascendancy marches.
- Kree will trade what they see, for a price.

entities.name: Aetheris
entities.summary:
> The land looks broken on purpose. Roads end in rubble. Towers lean over valleys with no towns left in them. Ruins of five different kinds of kingdom stand on the same hillside, none of them finished, all of them fought over. Wherever you go, somebody's banner flies over somebody else's ruins, and everyone you meet carries a weapon and a grudge.

**What you know**

- Aetheris is a shattered continent of ruins, scavengers, warbands, zealots and conspiracies.
- For as long as anyone can count, the world was remade over and over. A faction would gather the shards of the Ethereal Crystal and rewrite everything. People called it the Cycle of Aetherfalls.
- The Cycle ended about thirty years ago. This is Year 31 Unbound. Nothing resets any more, and history now piles up.
- There are twelve shards. Five great factions still want them.
- Magic and power have a price here: memory, name, blood or sanity.
- The first regular ships have begun crossing the [Black Tides](/player/e/LOC-902) to [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301).

| Dominion | Faction | Capital | Lies |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| The [Radiant Ascendancy](/player/e/REG-002) | [Celestial Order](/player/e/FAC-001) | [Empyrean Spire](/player/e/SET-010) | North |
| The [Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003) | [Crimson Legion](/player/e/FAC-002) | [Varkhaal](/player/e/SET-011) | East |
| The [Fractured Nexus](/player/e/REG-004) | [Arcane Consortium](/player/e/FAC-003) | [Zepharyos](/player/e/SET-012) | North-west |
| The [Eternal Veil](/player/e/REG-005) | [Shadow Pact](/player/e/FAC-004) | [Noctis](/player/e/SET-013) | West |
| The [Verdant Rebirth](/player/e/REG-006) | [Wildborn Clans](/player/e/FAC-005) | The [Rootspire](/player/e/SET-014) | South |

The [Hollow Marches](/player/e/REG-001) sit in the middle, and nobody rules them.

**Getting around**

Each dominion's border is about a week from [Hollow Refuge](/player/e/SET-001). Each capital is about another week past its border.

**What people say**

- Before the gods there was Fire, and it still burns somewhere.
- The skeletons of gods lie where they fell, at a place called the [Titan's Fall](/player/e/LOC-005).
- There was a war nobody remembers. They call it the Bloodless War.
- A city was stolen from the surface and sunk under the sea.
- The [Silent Accord](/player/e/CLT-006) whispers that the Aetherfall was a prison, built by something older than anyone guesses.

entities.name: Aetheris Backgrounds
entities.summary:
*Twelve backgrounds for a character from [Aetheris](/player/e/CON-001).*

Each background gives two skills, one tool and an origin feat, plus the usual three ability score choices.

| Background | Who you were | Skills | Tool | Origin feat |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Refuge Scavenger | You grew up picking through the Marches' battlefields. | Investigation, Sleight of Hand | Thieves' Tools | Lucky |
| Legion Deserter | You swore to [Karrath](/player/e/DEI-902), and walked away anyway. | Athletics, Survival | One gaming set | Tough |
| Celestial Acolyte | You were raised in the Order's light. | Insight, Religion | Calligrapher's Supplies | Magic Initiate (Cleric) |
| Consortium Apprentice | You studied in a Consortium tower, until you didn't. | Arcana, History | Calligrapher's Supplies | Magic Initiate (Wizard) |
| Pact Informant | You sold secrets for the [Shadow Pact](/player/e/FAC-004). | Deception, Stealth | Forgery Kit | Alert |
| Wildborn Outrider | You rode for a Wildborn clan. | Nature, Survival | Herbalism Kit | Magic Initiate (Druid) |
| Shardwar Orphan | Your family died in a fight over a shard. | Insight, Stealth | Thieves' Tools | Tavern Brawler |
| Failed Noble | Your house fell when the Cycle broke. | History, Persuasion | One gaming set | Skilled |
| Archive Delver | You read what others buried. | Arcana, Investigation | Cartographer's Tools | Crafter |
| Aetherfall Survivor | You remember the last Aetherfall, a little. | History, Perception | Herbalism Kit | Lucky |
| Mercenary | You fought for whoever paid. | Athletics, Intimidation | One gaming set | Savage Attacker |
| Cult Escapee | You got out of a cult. It hasn't forgotten you. | Deception, Religion | Disguise Kit | Alert |

entities.name: Althisa "the Saltborn"
entities.summary:
*A water genasi who drifts instead of walking and remembers only the sea.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Water Genasi | Shaman | She/her | The [Black Tides](/player/e/LOC-902) |

**Looks.** A water genasi with pale blue skin and hair that flows like a current. Her feet never quite touch the ground.

**Manner.** Distant and peaceful. Calls everyone by the names of fish.

**Who they are**

- A figure of the [Drowned Saints](/player/e/CLT-003).

**What people say**

- Althisa drifts instead of walking.
- Althisa remembers nothing but the sea.

entities.name: Ancestries Across the World
entities.summary:
*Some peoples go by different names on each continent, and tell different stories of where they came from.*

The same peoples live on both continents, and they use the same rules. Some go by different names, and each continent tells its own story of where they came from. Neither story is wrong; they just disagree.

| In [Aetheris](/player/e/CON-001) | In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) |
| --- | --- |
| [Taur'n](/player/e/PPL-007) | Minotaurs |
| [Shadowkin](/player/e/PPL-006) | Shadar-kai |
| [Reptilians](/player/e/PPL-005) | Lizardfolk |

Humans, elves, dwarves and orcs live everywhere, under the same names. So do most other peoples: see each people's page.

Two names are Aetheris's own. [Moonborn](/player/e/PPL-008) were Wildborn druids who could step into the spirit world, and perhaps only one is left. [Stormborn](/player/e/PPL-013) are people born in a thunderstorm, with the storm still in them.

entities.name: Anchor-Master Wenna Gale
entities.summary:
*[Driftholm](/player/e/SET-021)'s Stormborn chain-keeper, who can talk the wind into anything.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Stormborn | Monk | She/her | Driftholm |

**Looks.** A wiry Stormborn woman with sky-blue skin, hair that streams upward, and rope burns on both palms.

**Manner.** Cheerful, fearless and always in a hurry.

**Who they are**

- Anchor-Master of Driftholm: keeper of the chains that hold the island down.
- Climbs the chains every day to check them, without a rope.

**What people say**

- She once rode a broken chain all the way down and walked back up.
- She's been offered a Consortium post twice. She laughed both times.

entities.name: Anvilreach
entities.summary:
*A vault in the northern highlands, where Kaelith forged something it called cores.*

Anvilreach lies in the northern highlands, under dwarf holds that were built over it on purpose. [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302)'s catalogue says Kaelith forged thirteen of something there, and named each one.

**What people say**

- The dwarves of the highlands say they were Kaelith's masons. They say less about Anvilreach.
- Whatever was forged there, it was made to be named.

entities.name: Arborhold
entities.summary:
*The vault in the [Eastern Deepwood](/player/e/REG-301) where a [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302) crew vanished in 22 AB.*

Arborhold lies deep in the Eastern Deepwood, behind a rune gate and a marker stone, at the foot of a stair of 273 steps. A Kaelholm repair crew went in in 22 AB and never came out. Nobody has passed the gate since. [Venn Tull](/player/e/NPC-308) would very much like someone to.

**What people say**

- The crew's names are still on Kaelholm's rolls. All but one.
- Something sleeps inside. Kaelholm wants it awake.

entities.name: Arcane Consortium
entities.summary:
*The mages of the Fractured Nexus: reality is a puzzle, and they mean to solve it.*

**What they want.** Limitless magic. Floating islands, shifting time, cities that move between worlds.

**What they promise.** A world no longer limited by ignorance.

**How they work.** Scholars, constructs, dimensional mercenaries and Eye Beasts. The Consortium funds research everywhere and asks very few questions about what it costs.

**Who leads.** [Archmagister Veylan Orithis](/player/e/NPC-034), with [Archivist Lissara Wynne](/player/e/NPC-035).

**Where.** The [The Fractured Nexus](/player/e/REG-004), ruled from [Zepharyos](/player/e/SET-012), City of the Unbound. Its chief fortress is the [Nexus Collegium](/player/e/LOC-048).

**Their sign.** A violet geometric eye, or a prism.

**Who opposes them.** The [Celestial Order](/player/e/FAC-001), which would erase forbidden magic, and the [Wildborn Clans](/player/e/FAC-005), who want less magic in the world, not more.

**Belonging.** The Consortium takes anyone with a talent or a question. Members are graded, ranked and published. Failures are written up too.

**What people say**

- The Consortium treats catastrophe as a research cost.
- Zepharyos is falling, a little, every year. The Consortium says it's fine.
- If you need something identified, ask a Consortium scholar. If you need it to stay yours, don't.

entities.name: Arcane Sentinel
entities.summary:
*An empty suit of armour that guards Consortium towers and fires bolts of force.*

> Armour with nothing inside, runes glowing at the joints, a palm that crackles.

**What you know**

- Guardians of the [Arcane Consortium](/player/e/FAC-003)'s towers.

**What people say**

- They never sleep and never forget a face.
- Someone is always watching through their eyes.

entities.name: Architects of Eternity
entities.summary:
*Builders of a world that can never be erased.*

**What they want.** To build something that will outlast any Aetherfall: a world nothing can unmake.

**Who leads.** [Kaelos "the Forgotten Star"](/player/e/NPC-066), who builds for what comes after.

**Where.** [The Crucible of Creation](/player/e/LOC-502), in the [Fields of Lost Realities](/player/e/ETH-502).

**What people say**

- They'll pay for salvage. They always want more.

entities.name: Archivist Lissara Wynne
entities.summary:
*Keeper of the Consortium's most dangerous books. Every answer has a price.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Elf | Mystic | She/her | The [Veilborn Archive](/player/e/LOC-054), the [Eternal Veil](/player/e/REG-005) |

**Looks.** A tall elf in archive greys with silver rings on every finger, each one engraved with the title of a book she has refused to lend.

**Manner.** Gracious, patient and impossible to rush. Every answer comes with a price.

**Who they are**

- Keeper of the [Arcane Consortium](/player/e/FAC-003)'s most dangerous texts, in [The Fractured Nexus](/player/e/REG-004).
- Learned her trade among the stone masks of the Veilborn Archive.

**What people say**

- Lissara Wynne trades knowledge. Never gives it.
- Whatever you want to know, Wynne will want something back.

entities.name: Archivist Teodor Wrenn
entities.summary:
*A mild [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302) archivist with an excellent memory for maps.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Human | Mystic | He/him | Kaelholm |

**Looks.** A thin, balding man in archivist grey, with spectacles mended with wire and a pleasant, forgettable face.

**Manner.** Helpful, quiet and always slightly too well informed.

**Who they are**

- An archivist of Kaelholm who keeps the map rooms.

**What people say**

- If a map exists, Wrenn has copied it.
- He never seems to leave the archive, but he knows what happens on the docks.

entities.name: Archivist-Elder Mirela Sand
entities.summary:
*The [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302) tribunal elder who decides whose names are burned.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dwarf | Cleric | She/her | The northern highlands |

**Looks.** A stout dwarf in tribunal grey with a white braid wound into a crown, and an iron stylus she uses for nothing but scraping.

**Manner.** Slow, formal and absolutely certain. Reads every charge aloud twice.

**Who they are**

- An Archivist-Elder of Kaelholm, who sits on the Sitting.
- Keeper of the Rasp, where burned names are scraped from the rolls.

**What people say**

- She has burned more names than any elder living.
- She keeps a list of every name she has scraped out, in her own hand.

entities.name: Archivist-Elder Venn Tull
entities.summary:
*A [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302) tribunal head who wants a living Kaelith guardian at any price.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Gnome | Artificer | She/her | Kaelholm |

**Looks.** A thin, upright gnome in tribunal grey, with a ledger under one arm and a small brass construct that follows two steps behind her.

**Manner.** Courteous, precise and impossible to refuse once she has decided she wants something.

**Who they are**

- Archivist-Elder of Kaelholm, and head of one of its tribunals.
- A glyph-wright, like many Kaelholm gnomes.
- Can "burn" a name: scrape it from every roll.

**What people say**

- She wants a living Kaelith guardian, and will pay anything to get one.
- Her pockets are deep.

entities.name: Archmagister Veylan Orithis
entities.summary:
*The tiny goblin archmage who leads the Consortium, one experiment from disaster.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Goblin | Mage | He/him | [Zepharyos](/player/e/SET-012), the Fractured Nexus |

**Looks.** A tiny old goblin with wild white ear-tufts, burn marks on every robe he owns, and spectacles that change colour on their own.

**Manner.** Brilliant, kind and alarmingly enthusiastic. Laughs when things explode.

**Who they are**

- Leader of the [Arcane Consortium](/player/e/FAC-003), the faction that rules [The Fractured Nexus](/player/e/REG-004).

**What people say**

- Orithis is brilliant.
- Orithis is one experiment away from going too far.
- Half of Zepharyos floats because of something he did by accident.

entities.name: Archon Vaelion
entities.summary:
*The Order's legendary first champion. Possibly alive. Possibly only an idea.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Centaur | Warrior | He/him | The [Radiant Expanse](/player/e/LOC-042), long ago |

**Looks.** Every statue shows a centaur in gilded barding with a lance and a sun-shield. No two statues agree on his face.

**Manner.** In the stories: courteous to enemies, merciless to cowards.

**Who they are**

- The [Celestial Order](/player/e/FAC-001)'s legendary first champion.

**What people say**

- The Archon still lives.
- The Archon is only an idea, kept alive because the Order needs one.
- Riders on the Expanse still swear they have galloped beside him at dawn.

entities.name: Archwell
entities.summary:
*A village built inside a fallen kingdom's gate, around a well that draws up water from somewhere else.*

> A stone arch taller than any tower stands alone in the grass, and the village has grown inside it like a nest in a skull. Washing hangs between the old gate-posts. In the middle of it all, a well with a bronze lid, and a queue of people waiting to see what comes up.

**What you know**

- A village of salvagers and farmers in the north-west Marches, built in the ruin of a great gate.
- Nobody knows what kingdom the gate belonged to. The stones have five different carvings, one over the other.
- Its well sometimes draws up water that tastes of the sea, or of snow, or of somewhere that isn't here.
- [Well-Warden Ysolde Varn](/player/e/NPC-362) keeps the well, and the village.

**Places in the village**

| Place | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| The Well | Bronze-lidded and very deep. Some days the bucket comes up full of salt water, some days with snow in it. |
| The Gate Hall | The hollow inside the arch, now the village hall, market and dancehall. |
| The Five Carvings | The arch's faces, each carved by a different world. Scholars come to copy them. |

**Getting to [Hollow Refuge](/player/e/SET-001).** A day's walk south-east, past the [Ashen Spire](/player/e/LOC-030).

**What people say**

- Last spring the well brought up a fish nobody could name. It's still alive, in a barrel.
- There's a sixth carving under the other five, and nobody can quite look at it.
- Consortium scholars pay well for a bucket from the well, on the right day.

entities.name: Ashen Spire
entities.summary:
*The ruined capital of the last great kingdom, picked over by scavengers and walked by restless spirits.*

> The tower is still standing, somehow: a black needle of stone above a city of collapsed roofs. Everything is grey with old ash. Scavenger flags flap on the rubble, three crews' worth, each pretending the others aren't there. As the light goes, you notice figures moving between the ruins who don't cast shadows.

**What you know**

- The capital of the last great kingdom, before it fell and the [Hollow Marches](/player/e/REG-001) became lawless.
- Now a ruin of scavengers, mercenaries and restless spirits.
- The Vale family were a minor house here.

**Places in the ruin**

| Place | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| The Needle | The last standing tower, black with old fire. |
| The Throne Steps | Where the last kings sat. The throne is gone. |
| Salvage Row | Where the scavenger crews camp, trade and fight. |

**Getting around.** Somewhere in the Marches, a hard road from [Hollow Refuge](/player/e/SET-001).

**What people say**

- Restless spirits still walk Ashen Spire.
- The spirits give warnings, but nobody understands them.
- Every crew wants to salvage the Needle first.

entities.name: Ashen Zealot
entities.summary:
*A fanatic of the [Ashen Covenant](/player/e/CLT-001) who burns for the world's rebirth.*

> Ash-grey robes, burn-scarred hands and a smile that does not flinch.

**What you know**

- Fanatics of the Ashen Covenant.

**What people say**

- They feel no pain, or say they do not.

entities.name: Ashvale
entities.summary:
> The town hugs the edge of the Rift like it's afraid to let go. Warm air comes up out of the crack and keeps the frost off the nearest roofs. In the middle of town, thirteen standing stones lean together in a ring, older than anything around them. The meeting hall beside them is only half finished, its timbers still raw. Out on the eastern edge, young trees stand in rows with their grafts bound in twine. Somebody near the stones is singing the same four lines over and over.

**What you know**

- Refugees founded Ashvale in 2 AB. They were led by a woman with burned palms, and she wrote the rite the town still keeps.
- Locals say everyone who sleeps in Ashvale is "a hand on the key". Ask them what the key opens and you'll mostly get a shrug.
- Children learn a four-line keeping song. It gets sung at the stones.
- Three groups run things, and they agree the rite must be kept. They don't agree on much else.

| Group | Leader | What they care about |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Boundary Keepers](/player/e/FAC-306) | [Ritekeeper Orla Hesk](/player/e/NPC-304) | Keeping the rite and the song, sung right. |
| [Bloom-Speakers](/player/e/FAC-307) | [Master Speaker Tevan Lin](/player/e/NPC-305) | Teaching communion with the [Bloom](/player/e/COS-301) safely, to anyone who asks. Their sanctuary is on the west edge of town. |
| [Wrights](/player/e/FAC-308) | [Chief Wright Brenna Halvor](/player/e/NPC-306) | Tools that work. They're planting the grafted orchard on the east side. |

**Around town**

- **The east gate** and **the west road** are the ways in and out. The west road crosses a ford.
- **The old waygate** is a ruin under the west road. The Wrights pay for salvage from it.
- **Nine villages** lie in the hills to the west and south: [Coldwater](/player/e/SET-320), [Haskett's Mill](/player/e/SET-321), [Greyfold](/player/e/SET-322), [Low Fenn](/player/e/SET-323), [Oakhallow](/player/e/SET-324), [Sallow Cross](/player/e/SET-325), [Kettleby](/player/e/SET-326), [Brannock](/player/e/SET-327) and [Thornmere](/player/e/SET-328).
- **[Odran Reeve](/player/e/NPC-312)** trades salt up from Low Fenn.

**What people say**

- No frost ever settles inside the ring of stones.
- Once, years back, the stones were "listening".
- Something still hums down in the old waygate.
- A green gourd-lamp has been showing up at the treeline at night.

entities.name: Ashvale Waygate
entities.summary:
*A ruined under-road station under [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301)'s west road, picked over by salvagers.*

Under Ashvale's west road, a stair goes down to a ruined halt of the under-roads, on the old line to somewhere east. Rune-sleds used to stop here. Now it's salvage country: the [Wrights](/player/e/FAC-308) pay well for anything that still works, and [Brenna Halvor](/player/e/NPC-306) pays best of all.

**What people say**

- Something down there still hums.
- The [Boundary Keepers](/player/e/FAC-306) don't like the Wrights digging so close to the stones.
- The old line runs east, all the way to the mountains. Nobody's walked it.

entities.name: Aurex, the Throne-Breaker
entities.summary:
*The god who tried to sit the Shattered Throne, and failed.*

Nobody knows what Aurex was god of. What everyone knows is how he died: he tried to sit [The Shattered Throne](/player/e/LOC-012), and the throne broke him instead. Nobody prays to him. Soldiers passing the Throne spit, for luck.

**What people say**

- Aurex wanted to rule the other gods. That's the story, anyway.
- If a god couldn't sit the Throne, nobody can. People keep trying.

entities.name: Avenger Seraph
entities.summary:
*A winged sentinel of light the [Celestial Order](/player/e/FAC-001) calls down in its holiest wars.*

> Wings of white fire, a face too bright to look at, and a sword that sings.

**What you know**

- Angelic sentinels that fight for the Celestial Order.
- They are rarely seen, and never forgotten.

**What people say**

- The Order can call them. Nobody knows what it costs.
- An Avenger Seraph has never lost a fight it was sent to win.

entities.name: Balar the Unchained
entities.summary:
*An escaped pit slave turned berserker. He fights for the Legion. Nobody owns him.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Goliath | Warrior | He/him | A slave pit in the [Ruins of the Old Kings](/player/e/LOC-046) |

**Looks.** A goliath with broken manacles still riveted to both wrists, which he refuses to remove.

**Manner.** Quiet and watchful, until he is not.

**Who they are**

- A berserker of the [Crimson Legion](/player/e/FAC-002), in [The Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003).
- Once a pit slave. Escaped.

**What people say**

- Balar fights for the Legion now, but nobody owns Balar.
- He goes looking for slavers on his days off.

entities.name: Black Sun Prophet
entities.summary:
*A preacher of the [Black Sun](/player/e/CLT-002) who calls the dark down.*

> Black robes, eyes painted out, and darkness pooling around their feet.

**What you know**

- Preachers of the Black Sun cult.

**What people say**

- Where they preach, the shadows get longer.

entities.name: Blackveil Fortress
entities.summary:
*An abandoned stronghold whose vaults may hold relics, and whose depths nobody returns from.*

> The fortress fills the valley: black walls, black towers, gates that hang open as if it left in a hurry. Nothing flies over it. The upper halls have been picked clean. The stairs going down have not.

**What you know**

- An abandoned stronghold in the [Hollow Marches](/player/e/REG-001).
- Its vaults may hold relics.
- People who go into its depths don't come back.

**Getting around**

| From Blackveil to | Time | How safe |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Hollow Refuge](/player/e/SET-001) | 1 day | Risky |
| The Rift | 1 day | Openly hostile |

**What people say**

- [Old Vara](/player/e/NPC-004) wants Blackveil metal, and pays well for it.
- There are names carved on the walls of one hall, hundreds of them.
- Somebody's planning a Blackveil job, and hiring.

entities.name: Blight
entities.summary:
*A walking tangle of twigs and thorns: one of the [Bloom](/player/e/COS-301)'s angry moods.*

> A bundle of twigs and thorns shaped like a person, creaking as it comes.

**What you know**

- One of the Bloom's moods, given a body.

**What people say**

- Blights rise where the Bloom has been hurt.

entities.name: Bloodfang Ravager
entities.summary:
*A huge wolf of the Bloodfang packs, or a person who has become one.*

> A wolf the size of a horse, scarred and red-muzzled, with too-clever eyes.

**What you know**

- Great wolves that run with the Wildborn and the Bloodfang camps.

**What people say**

- Some Bloodfang Ravagers were people once.
- They remember faces.

entities.name: Bloom-Speakers
entities.summary:
*[Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301)'s teachers of safe communion with the [Bloom](/player/e/COS-301).*

**What they want.** Communion with the Bloom, taught safely, to anyone who asks.

**How they work.** They tend the Bloom around Ashvale and teach from their sanctuary on the west edge of town. Their members carry copper-dark binding lines on the forearms.

**Who leads.** [Master Speaker Tevan Lin](/player/e/NPC-305).

**Who they argue with.** The [Boundary Keepers](/player/e/FAC-306), who guard the old restrictions.

entities.name: Bloom-shift
entities.summary:
*A visible line where the [Bloom](/player/e/COS-301) changes character, and the dead zones beyond it.*

> A line on the ground where the moss changes colour, sharp as a knife cut. Past it, everything is grey and silent.

**What you know**

- Visible lines where the Bloom's growth changes character.
- In a dead zone, the Bloom closes on anyone it reads as a stranger.

**What people say**

- There is a dead zone in the [Eastern Deepwood](/player/e/REG-301) that even the [Spore Circle](/player/e/FAC-302) avoids.

entities.name: Bloomborn
entities.summary:
*People of bark, moss, root and fungus, grown from the first years of the [Bloom](/player/e/COS-301).*

In the first years of the Bloom, the spore-storms rewrote some people into beast-folk. A few they rewrote further, all the way into the Bloom's own grammar. Their descendants are the Bloomborn: people of bark, moss, root and fungus.

They are people, not the Bloom's moods. They have names, families, grudges and opinions, and they choose for themselves.

**Strengths and flaws.** Patient, hardy and hard to kill. Natural growers and healers. Slow to trust, slower to forget, and they always smell faintly of rain on soil.

**Culture.** Most Bloomborn live in the open Bloom country and the [Eastern Deepwood](/player/e/REG-301). Many walk with the [Spore Circle](/player/e/FAC-302). Some work [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301)'s orchards beside the [Wrights](/player/e/FAC-308). [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302) studies them with fascination and suspicion. The [Convergence Collective](/player/e/FAC-304) calls them proof that the change can be lived. Plenty of ordinary folk just find them restful company.

Bloomborn grow no husk against the Bloom, since they are already part of it. They feel its moods the way others feel weather. A very few have crossed to [Aetheris](/player/e/CON-001), where nobody knows what to make of them.

**Common names.** Alder, Bracken, Corrin, Fennick, Hollin, Rue, Sedge, Tansy, Thistle, Wren

**At the table.** Use the firbolg rules, or a custom lineage.

entities.name: Bone Herald
entities.summary:
*A dead court's messenger, all claws and courtesy, sent to fetch you.*

> A tall skeletal thing in rotten court livery, with claws like scythes, bowing very low. It has an invitation for you.

**Where.** The [Ossuary of Kings](/player/e/ETH-503).

**What you know**

- The dead courts of the Ossuary send them with invitations.
- Refusing politely usually works.

**What people say**

- A Bone Herald's invitation gets you into the deep realm. It doesn't say you'll leave.
- Refuse it rudely and it stays.

entities.name: Boundary Keepers
entities.summary:
*[Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301)'s keepers of the rite, who sing the keeping song at the stones.*

**What they want.** The old rites kept, and the lid held.

**How they work.** They sing the keeping song at Ashvale's standing stones, and make sure it is sung right.

**Who leads.** [Ritekeeper Orla Hesk](/player/e/NPC-304).

**Who they argue with.** The [Bloom-Speakers](/player/e/FAC-307), who want to teach what the Keepers would rather keep closed. Ashvale's three groups agree on the rite and little else.

entities.name: Brann Kest
entities.summary:
*A shardscarred veteran who has not slept a full night in years.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Half-orc | Warrior | He/him | The [Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003) |

**Looks.** A tired half-orc veteran whose arms are crossed with glassy, glittering scars where shard-fragments went in.

**Manner.** Polite and very tired. Drinks coffee by the pot.

**Who they are**

- A shardscarred veteran in [Hollow Refuge](/player/e/SET-001).
- Wants to stop dreaming.

**What people say**

- He has not slept a full night in years.
- Do not wake him suddenly.

entities.name: Brannock
entities.summary:
*A tough hill village of goliaths and humans, grieving its children lost to the east.*

> Brannock sits on a bare ridge where the wind never stops. Its houses are low and thick-walled, roofed with turf. Axes hang beside every door. A huge goliath woman is splitting firewood in the square, and every stroke sounds angry.

**What you know**

- A hill village on a high ridge in the west, where goliaths and humans have lived together for generations.
- Its young people go east to the mountains for work, and some come back changed.
- [Thane Gerda Brannock](/player/e/NPC-353) leads it.

**Places in the village**

| Place | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| The Ridge Hall | The thane's hall, where the village eats together in winter. |
| The Wind Stones | Standing stones on the ridge, where the young swear oaths before leaving. |
| The East Road Gate | Where those who go east say goodbye. Names are carved on the posts. |

**Getting to [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301).** A day and a half east, over the ridges.

**What people say**

- The thane's nephew went east to the [Ascendancy](/player/e/FAC-305) and came back with an iron jaw.
- Gerda will not let another Brannock child go east.
- Ascendancy recruiters have been seen on the east road.

entities.name: Briar Mother
entities.summary:
*A hag of thorns who trades favours for memories.*

> An old woman of twisted briar and green skin, sitting in a thicket, smiling with too many teeth.

**What you know**

- A hag of the deep forest who bargains for memories.

**What people say**

- She will give you anything. Ask her what it cost you afterwards, if you can remember.

entities.name: Briar Wolf
entities.summary:
*A wolf grown through with thorns, that runs with the Wildborn.*

> A lean wolf with briars growing through its fur and blood on its thorns.

**What you know**

- Thorned wolves of the [Verdant Rebirth](/player/e/REG-006).

**What people say**

- Their bite leaves thorns behind.

entities.name: Brindle Quickfoot
entities.summary:
*A harengon trader who deals in things salvaged from the [Fields of Lost Realities](/player/e/ETH-502).*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Harengon | Mage | He/him | The [Hollow Marches](/player/e/REG-001), once |

**Looks.** A sandy-furred harengon in a coat of patched velvet, with a trader's pack bigger than he is.

**Manner.** Chatty, quick and honest, mostly.

**Who they are**

- Trades in salvage from the edge of the Fields of Lost Realities.
- Runs the Lost Shelf at the [Nameless Asylum](/player/e/LOC-506).

**What people say**

- Brindle can find anything. He can't always find its owner.
- He never goes further into the Fields than the edge. He says that's why he's still alive.

entities.name: Brother Altharion Vale
entities.summary:
*Eldest of the Vales: a Wildborn warrior turned Order monk.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Human | Monk | He/him | [Ashen Spire](/player/e/LOC-030), the [Hollow Marches](/player/e/REG-001) |

**Looks.** A weathered man in his forties, head shaved, in a plain undyed habit. Wildborn tattoos of antlers still run down both forearms.

**Manner.** Gentle and economical. Moves like a hunter even when he is sweeping a floor.

**Who they are**

- A monk of the [Celestial Order](/player/e/FAC-001), in [The Radiant Ascendancy](/player/e/REG-002).
- Once a Wildborn warrior.
- Eldest of the Vale family, a minor house of Ashen Spire. Brother to [Tobias Vale](/player/e/NPC-051), [Professor Orin Vale](/player/e/NPC-007) and [Sister Elyra Vale](/player/e/NPC-006).

**What people say**

- The hunt still calls him.
- The Vales ended up on every side there is.
- He still writes to his brother. Neither of them answers.

entities.name: Brynn Wolfsong
entities.summary:
*A shifter who leads a great wolf pack and wants the Clans to stand as one.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shifter | Ranger | They/them | [Fangholt](/player/e/LOC-056), the Verdant Rebirth |

**Looks.** A shifter with grey wolf's eyes and a mane of grey hair, always surrounded by wolves.

**Manner.** Warm, loud and loyal. Howls instead of cheering.

**Who they are**

- A leader of the [Wildborn Clans](/player/e/FAC-005), in [The Verdant Rebirth](/player/e/REG-006).
- Leads a great wolf pack.

**What people say**

- Brynn wants the Clans to stand as one.
- Some clans would rather fight each other than follow a shifter.

entities.name: Bugbears
entities.summary:
*Big, quiet and much stealthier than anyone expects, until they decide to be noticed.*

Bugbears came out of the eastern hills of the [Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003) and now turn up anywhere there's work for someone large and patient. Plenty work for the Legion. Plenty, like the innkeeper of the Crooked Nail in [Hollow Refuge](/player/e/SET-001), very definitely don't.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) bugbears keep to the [Eastern Deepwood](/player/e/REG-301) and the woodcutting villages, and they've a name as trackers and guides the Scholar Corps relies on.

**Strengths and flaws.** Long-armed, strong and silent on their feet. Taken for brutes, and they've learned to use it.

**Culture.** Close-knit families, long silences, and a dry sense of humour that takes years to notice.

**Common names.** Bruk, Gorra, Hask, Mog, Nargu, Rusk, Tharg, Ulla

**At the table.** Use the bugbear rules.

entities.name: Calendar
entities.summary:
*One 363-day year, shared by both continents, and its holy days.*

Both continents keep the same year of 363 days: twelve 30-day months in four seasons, plus three festival days that belong to no month. A week has seven days. It's 300 After [Bloom](/player/e/COS-301) (AB) in [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) and Year 31 Unbound in [Aetheris](/player/e/CON-001).

| Season | Months | Festivals |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spring | Spring Dawn, First Seed, Monsoon | Spring Equinox, before Spring Dawn 1, is New Year's Day. |
| Summer | Midnight Sun, Dry Wind, Harvest | Midsummer falls on Midnight Sun 15. |
| Autumn | Fall, Last Seed, Old Winds | Autumn Equinox, before Fall 1. |
| Winter | Snowfall, Evernight, Winter's Dusk | Evernight Festival, between Evernight 30 and Winter's Dusk 1. |

**Holy days and festivals**

| When | Festival | What happens |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spring Equinox | **First Light** ([Solenne](/player/e/DEI-901)) | New Year's Day. Lamps are put out the night before and relit at dawn from a neighbour's. Feuds are supposed to end. |
| Spring Equinox, in Kaelmar | **Bloom Eve** | The night before, Kaelmar remembers the Shrouding. Families sit up with the doors shut, and open them together at dawn. |
| Spring Dawn 1, in Aetheris | **[First Morning](/player/e/HIS-010)** | Nobody sleeps the night before. At dawn, people go outside to check the world is still there. It always has been, so far. |
| First Seed 1 | **Seedwake** ([Orrowen](/player/e/DEI-905)) | The first seed is sung into the ground. |
| Monsoon 1 | **The Sundering** ([Maruun](/player/e/DEI-907)) | The [Drowned Saints](/player/e/CLT-003) mourn the sea's god at the docks. Everyone else stays home. |
| Midnight Sun 15 | **Midsummer** and **the Red Games** ([Karrath](/player/e/DEI-902)) | Bonfires everywhere; the great tournament in [Varkhaal](/player/e/SET-011)'s Great Arena. |
| Dry Wind 20 | **The Long Watch** ([Ithiel](/player/e/DEI-903)) | A night of counting stars. Children learn to steer by them. |
| Harvest 30 | **Harvest Home** (Orrowen) | The last sheaf is left in the field. |
| Autumn Equinox | **Naming Day** ([Sephane](/player/e/DEI-906)) | The year's dead are named and carved on the Name Stones. |
| Old Winds 30 | **Masking Night** ([Ellun](/player/e/DEI-904)) | Masks in the street, and nothing done behind one counts. A week long in [Noctis](/player/e/SET-013). |
| Evernight Festival | **Evernight** | The longest night. Every household keeps a light burning till dawn, and nobody travels. In [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301), the keeping song is sung at the stones all night. |

**What people say**

- Evernight is the one festival everybody keeps. Nobody wants to be the house with the dark window.
- In the Marches, both First Morning and Bloom Eve are kept now, since the ships started coming. Any excuse.

entities.name: Captain Bell Ottery
entities.summary:
*The halfling river-captain who runs the salt barges from the coast to the hills.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Halfling | Silent Blade | He/him | The southern river country |

**Looks.** A wiry halfling in a red neckerchief, captain of a flat-bottomed barge with a goat for a figurehead.

**Manner.** Cocky, charming and absolutely reliable.

**Who they are**

- Captain of the halfling salt barges of [The Southern Fens, Lakes and River Country](/player/e/REG-305).

**What people say**

- His barges carry salt up from the coast for [Odran Reeve](/player/e/NPC-312).
- He has smuggled people as well as salt.

entities.name: Captain Marrek Vaal
entities.summary:
*A centaur Legion captain in the Marches who always keeps his word.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Centaur | Warrior | He/him | The [Bloodfields](/player/e/LOC-045), the [Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003) |

**Looks.** A grey-coated centaur in red-lacquered barding, with a captain's braid and a scarred, careful face.

**Manner.** Formal and honest. Says exactly what he will do, then does it.

**Who they are**

- A [Crimson Legion](/player/e/FAC-002) officer in [The Hollow Marches](/player/e/REG-001).
- Keeps his agreements.

**What people say**

- Every faction would rather deal with Vaal than with his superiors.
- He has never broken his word, which in the Legion makes people nervous.

entities.name: Captain Tor Varga
entities.summary:
*The centaur captain of the Collective's Warband, who rides beside half-living constructs.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Centaur | Warrior | He/him | The ash barrens |

**Looks.** A grey-coated centaur in grafted barding, with a lance of hatch-metal and an iron graft along one foreleg.

**Manner.** Blunt, loyal and funny in a dry way.

**Who they are**

- Captain of the Warband of [The Convergence Collective](/player/e/FAC-304).
- Rides with half-living constructs and the beast-folk of the barrens.

**What people say**

- His Warband would follow him into the Rift.
- He has fought the [Ascendancy](/player/e/FAC-305)'s columns twice and won both times.

entities.name: Cassiel "the False Dawn"
entities.summary:
*A fallen Order paladin who decided the gods lied.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Aasimar | Mage | He/him | [Empyrean Spire](/player/e/SET-010), the [Radiant Ascendancy](/player/e/REG-002) |

**Looks.** An aasimar whose inner light has dimmed to a cold violet. He wears his old Order armour painted black.

**Manner.** Bitter, eloquent and still, underneath it all, hurt.

**Who they are**

- A figure of the [Black Sun](/player/e/CLT-002).
- Once a paladin of the [Celestial Order](/player/e/FAC-001).

**What people say**

- Cassiel decided the gods lied.

entities.name: Cazrin "the Hollow Blade"
entities.summary:
*A Pact enforcer whose name and past were taken from him.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Half-elf | Silent Blade | He/him | Unknown |

**Looks.** A plain half-elf in black with an empty sheath at his hip. When he fights, a blade of grey light fills it.

**Manner.** Flat, dutiful and strangely sad. Answers to "Cazrin" a moment too late.

**Who they are**

- An enforcer of the [Shadow Pact](/player/e/FAC-004), in [The Eternal Veil](/player/e/REG-005).

**What people say**

- The Pact took Cazrin's name and past.
- "Cazrin" is just what is left.

entities.name: Celestial Inquisitor
entities.summary:
*A hunter of heretics who brands the guilty with a mark that smothers magic.*

> A grey coat over plate, a burning sigil on one palm, and a quiet, patient voice.

**What you know**

- The Order's heretic-hunters.
- Their mark makes magic stumble.

**What people say**

- When an inquisitor arrives, someone is already guilty.
- The mark fades in a year, if you live that long.

entities.name: Celestial Order
entities.summary:
*The golden theocracy of the Radiant Ascendancy: divine law, purity, and a sun that never sets.*

**What they want.** A golden theocracy under a sun that never sets. Undead, demons and forbidden magic wiped out, and, their rivals add, dissent wiped out with them.

**What they promise.** Peace through enlightened order.

**How they work.** Radiant knights, inquisitors, seraphs and missionary healers. The healers build hospitals in every dominion; the inquisitors follow them.

**Who leads.** [Highlord Theos Valcairn](/player/e/NPC-015), with [Grand Theurgist Selara Dawnveil](/player/e/NPC-016) and [Inquisitor Malrik Vael](/player/e/NPC-017).

**Where.** The [The Radiant Ascendancy](/player/e/REG-002), ruled from [Empyrean Spire](/player/e/SET-010). Its chief fortress is the [Golden Aerie](/player/e/LOC-041).

**Their sign.** A rising golden sun.

**Who opposes them.** Everyone the Order would purify: the [Arcane Consortium](/player/e/FAC-003), the [Shadow Pact](/player/e/FAC-004) and the [Wildborn Clans](/player/e/FAC-005) most of all.

**Belonging.** Order knights swear to [Solenne](/player/e/DEI-901) and to the Highlord, in that order, at least officially. A member gets protection, purpose and a place in a world that makes sense. They also get watched.

**What people say**

- The Order calls obedience "harmony".
- Its healers will treat anyone. Its knights won't.
- Nobody lives in the [Purged Halls](/player/e/LOC-043) any more.

entities.name: Centaurs
entities.summary:
*Horse-bodied wanderers of the open plains, who measure the world in a day's gallop.*

Centaur herds cross the [Radiant Expanse](/player/e/LOC-042) and the open land of the [Hollow Marches](/player/e/REG-001), and their routes are older than the borders. Every dominion has tried to tax them. None has managed it twice.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) centaurs roam the open [Bloom](/player/e/COS-301) country, where the spore-storms first rewrote them. Their herds travel ahead of the storms, and villages watch them to know when weather's coming.

**Strengths and flaws.** Fast, strong and tireless over open ground. Uncomfortable in cities, cellars and anywhere with stairs.

**Culture.** Herds, long migrations, and star-lore for finding the way.

**Common names.** Arren, Callis, Dovren, Kaya, Merrow, Sabine, Torvald, Yessa

**At the table.** Use the centaur rules.

entities.name: Centurion
entities.summary:
*A Legion officer whose bark can move a whole line at once.*

> A plumed helm, a scarred face and a voice like a slammed door.

**What you know**

- The Legion's field officers.
- They command their soldiers in the middle of a fight.

**What people say**

- Kill the centurion and the line wavers.
- Every centurion won the rank in a duel.

entities.name: Champion Valrik the Undying
entities.summary:
*The Legion's stone-skinned champion, who has never been seen to fall.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Earth Genasi | Warrior | She/her | The Great Arena of [Varkhaal](/player/e/SET-011) |

**Looks.** An earth genasi whose skin is grey stone veined with quartz. Old wounds have healed into seams of raw crystal.

**Manner.** Calm and courteous to opponents. Thanks them after every fight, whether or not they can hear.

**Who they are**

- The [Crimson Legion](/player/e/FAC-002)'s champion, in [The Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003).
- Raised in the Great Arena.

**What people say**

- Valrik has never been seen to fall.
- Valrik survives wounds that should kill.
- [Karrath](/player/e/DEI-902)'s priests say the Red Victor will not let her die until she loses.

entities.name: Chandler Ossery Thane
entities.summary:
*[Tallowmarch](/player/e/SET-016)'s guild-master, a half-orc candlemaker with a monk's patience and a merchant's nose.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Half-orc | Monk | He/him | Tallowmarch |

**Looks.** A big, slow-moving half-orc with burn-scarred hands, a leather apron and a beard that smells of honey.

**Manner.** Patient, kind and immovable in a bargain.

**Who they are**

- Master of the chandlers' guild, and so headman of Tallowmarch.
- Trained once in a monastery he won't name. Still keeps its hours.

**What people say**

- His candles burn twice as long as anyone else's.
- He used to be something other than a candlemaker. He won't say what.

entities.name: Changelings
entities.summary:
*People who can wear any face, and who sometimes forget which one was theirs.*

Changelings live hidden in every city of [Aetheris](/player/e/CON-001), and the [Shadow Pact](/player/e/FAC-004) employs more of them than anyone admits. In [Noctis](/player/e/SET-013), where everyone wears a mask, they're the only people who don't need one. Nobody knows where they came from. Neither do they.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) changelings are rare, and [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302)'s rolls make them nervous: a name in a roll is only useful if it stays attached to one face.

**Strengths and flaws.** Any face, any voice. Trusted by nobody, once found out.

**Culture.** Chosen family, private names, and a habit of keeping one face only for friends.

**Common names.** Ash, Cael, Ivy, Lark, Nim, Quill, Sev, Tam

**At the table.** Use the changeling rules.

entities.name: Character Options and Backgrounds
entities.summary:
*How to play the people and callings of [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301), and seven backgrounds for a character from there.*

**Kaelmar's roles at the table**

| If you want to play | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Anyone from Kaelmar | Any people with a page in the handbook. |
| A woken guardian or vessel | Warforged, or a reskinned goliath or dwarf. You'd be the first to wake. Ask your GM. |
| A glyph-wright or vault-breaker | Artificer, or a rogue (Thief) or wizard, with Tinker's Tools and Thieves' Tools. |
| A spore-bound druid or Bloom-Speaker | Druid (Circle of the Land) or ranger. |
| A Boundary Keeper | Bard (College of Lore) or a cleric of [Sephane](/player/e/DEI-906). The keeping song is your spellcasting focus. |
| A Wright | Artificer, fighter or rogue with the Crafter feat. |
| A Warband rider or Riftwalker | Barbarian (Path of the World Tree) or paladin (Oath of the Ancients). |
| A glyph-burned visionary | Warlock (Great Old One) or sorcerer (Aberrant Sorcery). |
| An [Ascendancy](/player/e/FAC-305) soldier | Fighter, with grafts described as armour and weapons. |
| A priest | A cleric of any of the shared gods. |

**Kaelmar backgrounds.** Each gives two skills, one tool and an origin feat, plus the usual three ability score choices.

| Background | Who you were | Skills | Tool | Origin feat |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Burned Scholar | [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302) scraped your name off its rolls. | Arcana, Investigation | Tinker's Tools | Skilled |
| Circle Initiate | You were taken into the [Spore Circle](/player/e/FAC-302). | Nature, Medicine | Herbalism Kit | Magic Initiate (Druid) |
| Stone-Singer | You sang at [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301)'s stones with the [Boundary Keepers](/player/e/FAC-306). | History, Performance | A musical instrument | Musician |
| Graft-Keeper | You tended the Wrights' grafted orchards. | Nature, Survival | Woodcarver's Tools | Crafter |
| Glyph-Cut | You were cut with glyphs in the Collective's Warband. | Religion, Intimidation | Calligrapher's Supplies | Tough |
| Camp Healer | You patched people up in camps and caravans. | Medicine, Persuasion | Herbalism Kit | Healer |

**Kaelmar's dangers.** Opening glass doors, riding root-roads and communing too deep wear away at who you are. Your GM will explain Thinning if it comes up. Keep a list of the people who know your true name.

entities.name: Chief Wright Brenna Halvor
entities.summary:
*Ashvale's Chief Wright: practical, generous, and always hiring.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Human | Artificer | She/her | [Haskett's Mill](/player/e/SET-321), near Ashvale |

**Looks.** A sturdy woman with sawdust in her hair, a grafting knife on her belt, and a clockwork dog that follows her everywhere.

**Manner.** Practical, impatient and generous with work.

**Who they are**

- Chief Wright of [The Wrights](/player/e/FAC-308) in [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301).
- Planting Ashvale's first grafted orchard.

**What people say**

- She pays well for salvage from the old waygate under the west road.
- She can make anything work, given time.

entities.name: Cinderlock
entities.summary:
*A vault in the ash barrens, which once held the fire that ran Kaelith.*

Cinderlock lies in the ash barrens, east of the centre. [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302)'s catalogue says its fire once ran the whole of Kaelith. The ground around it is warm all year.

**What people say**

- The orc herders winter their flocks on the warm ground, and don't dig.
- What burned there once could burn again.

entities.name: Circuit-root
entities.summary:
*Glassy, glowing roots that carry food, memory and gossip.*

> Roots like glass, lit from within, pulsing slowly along the tunnel walls.

**What you know**

- Roots that carry food, memory and gossip through the under-roads.
- Trackers listen through them.

**What people say**

- Say nothing near a circuit-root you would not want heard.

entities.name: Coldwater
entities.summary:
*A cold, high sheep village where the springs never freeze and the wool is the best in the hills.*

> The track climbs until the trees give up. Stone walls run over the hills in every direction, and sheep crop the grass between them. The village is a huddle of grey houses around a spring that steams in the cold. Somebody's dog has already seen you, and somebody's reeve is already walking down to meet you.

**What you know**

- A shepherds' village high in the hills west of [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301).
- Its wool is the best in the hills, and it trades it down to Ashvale and [Haskett's Mill](/player/e/SET-321).
- Its spring never freezes, even in Evernight.
- [Reeve Hanna Colt](/player/e/NPC-346) runs it.

**Places in the village**

| Place | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| The Warm Spring | The steaming spring at the heart of the village, where everyone draws water and trades news. |
| The Shearing Barn | The biggest building in Coldwater, used for everything from shearing to weddings. |
| The Fold Stones | A ring of old sheep-folds on the hill above the village, older than anyone remembers. |

**Getting to Ashvale.** About a day's walk east, down out of the hills.

**What people say**

- One of Coldwater's children has been having strange dreams, and the reeve is frightened.
- The spring was warm long before anyone built the village.
- Coldwater sheep will not graze inside the Fold Stones.

entities.name: Corin Tull
entities.summary:
*Venn Tull's restless nephew, who leads the Scholar Corps' expeditions into the wild.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Gnome | Ranger | He/him | [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302) |

**Looks.** A wiry young gnome in a battered field coat bristling with specimen tubes, and a scar across one eyebrow from a thinking-rot burn.

**Manner.** Eager, reckless and funny. Hates offices.

**Who they are**

- Expedition captain of the Scholar Corps.
- Nephew of [Archivist-Elder Venn Tull](/player/e/NPC-308).

**What people say**

- He has been into the [Eastern Deepwood](/player/e/REG-301) more times than anyone in the Corps, and come back every time.
- His aunt pays his debts, and he has a lot of them.

entities.name: Cradlehorn
entities.summary:
*A vault in the eastern mountains, where Kaelith grew its iron vessels.*

Somewhere in the eastern mountains, Kaelith grew bodies: iron vessels for minds that never came. [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302)'s catalogue calls it the vault of vessels. Nobody has found its door.

**What people say**

- The vessels are still in there, asleep.
- Mercenaries in the eastern mountains have been asking about it.

entities.name: Crimson Legion
entities.summary:
*The war-host of the Tyrant's Dominion: only the strong deserve to rule.*

**What they want.** Endless war. Every settlement a fortress, every dispute a duel, an arena in every city.

**What they promise.** Strength that can survive anything.

**How they work.** Shock troopers, centurions, scouts, gladiators and siege companies. Rank is won in fights, and lost the same way.

**Who leads.** [Warlord Garron Kael](/player/e/NPC-024), with [General Orana Volkash](/player/e/NPC-025). The Warlord's heir is [Darion Kael](/player/e/NPC-033).

**Where.** The [The Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003), ruled from [Varkhaal](/player/e/SET-011). Its chief fortress is the [Red Bastion](/player/e/LOC-044).

**Their sign.** A crimson blade, or a clenched fist.

**Who opposes them.** The [Celestial Order](/player/e/FAC-001), which converts Legion captives, and the [Wildborn Clans](/player/e/FAC-005), across the [Bloodfields](/player/e/LOC-045).

**Belonging.** Anyone can join the Legion. Staying in it means winning. Members swear to [Karrath](/player/e/DEI-902) on their weapons, and an oath sworn that way can't be taken back.

**What people say**

- The Legion defines strength as whatever helps the Legion.
- Every Legion town has an arena. Most have two.
- The Warlord's son writes poetry. Nobody says it to the Warlord's face.

entities.name: Crowned Dead
entities.summary:
*A dead monarch of an erased kingdom, still holding court, and terrified of finally dying.*

> A skeleton in three crowns, one on top of the other, on a throne of other thrones. Its courtiers are bones. Its voice shakes.

**Where.** The [Ossuary of Kings](/player/e/ETH-503).

**What you know**

- Rulers who fled the Cycle to the Ossuary, and can now truly die.
- They are afraid, and fear makes them cruel.

**What people say**

- They'll offer you anything to protect them. They have nothing left to give.
- Every crown is from a different world.

entities.name: Cycle Breakers
entities.summary:
*The people who escaped the Cycle, and mean never to be rewritten again.*

**What they want.** A world that can't be rewritten, ever again.

**Who they are.** Those who slipped free of the Cycle over its many turns. The oldest of them, [Eryndor the First Shard](/player/e/NPC-063), was the first to break free, and remembers what came before.

**Where.** They meet at [The Fractured Throne](/player/e/LOC-503), in the [Ossuary of Kings](/player/e/ETH-503).

**What people say**

- They've been free longer than anyone. They're still arguing about what to do with it.

entities.name: Dangers and Death in the Ethereal Realm
entities.summary:
*What the realm does to the people who walk in it.*

**Old memories.** Meet something from a life you've forgotten, and a fragment of it comes back to you.

**The last threshold.** Crossing the Verge's last threshold brings back every life you've ever lived, all at once, and you can't undo it. The [Veilborn](/player/e/FAC-503) call it Awakening. Some people in the realm don't like the Awakened.

**True death.** In the deep realm, death is final. No spell, no relic and no wish brings anyone back.

**Unmaking.** Worse, someone who dies in the deep realm is erased from history. Their statues change. Their families remember someone else. Their friends who crossed the threshold with them keep only a sense of loss.

**At the table.** If a character is Unmade, each surviving companion writes one true sentence about them. It changes nothing in the rules, and everything at the table.

**What people say**

- In the Verge, you can die like anywhere else. Past the threshold, you can die like nowhere else.
- Say your friends' names out loud every day. It helps.

entities.name: Darion Kael
entities.summary:
*The Warlord's ink-stained heir, who doubts that war is the only path.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hobgoblin | Bard | He/him | [Varkhaal](/player/e/SET-011), the Tyrant's Dominion |

**Looks.** A slim young hobgoblin in fine red coats, with ink on his fingers and no scars at all, which in Varkhaal is its own kind of scandal.

**Manner.** Charming, careful and always listening. Asks soldiers about their families.

**Who they are**

- Son and heir of [Warlord Garron Kael](/player/e/NPC-024), in [The Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003).

**What people say**

- Darion doubts that war is the only path.
- Plenty in the Legion are waiting to see what that means when the heir inherits.
- He has friends in every faction, and his father knows about only some of them.

entities.name: Dawnmere
entities.summary:
*A pilgrim town on the long road to the [Luminara Gate](/player/e/LOC-007), all white walls and very strict rules.*

> White walls, white roofs, white dust on the road. Dawnmere sits beside a still lake that holds the sky like a mirror, and every building faces east. Pilgrims in grey robes queue at the gate to have their papers checked, and Order knights check them slowly. Somewhere a bell is counting the hour, and everyone stops to listen.

**What you know**

- A pilgrim town in the [Radiant Ascendancy](/player/e/REG-002), on the road from [Empyrean Spire](/player/e/SET-010) to the Luminara Gate.
- Every building faces east, so the dawn reaches every door.
- Its rules are strict, and its magistrate enforces every one.
- [Magistrate Seline Ashby](/player/e/NPC-366) keeps the law here.

**Places in the town**

| Place | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| The Mirror Lake | A still lake that reflects the sky so perfectly that birds fly into it. |
| The Pilgrim Hall | Where travellers are fed, housed, counted and watched. |
| The Bell of Hours | A great bell that rings every hour, day and night. In Dawnmere, everything stops when it rings. |

**Getting around.** Empyrean Spire is about three days south-west; the Luminara Gate about four days north-east, on foot, as pilgrims go.

**What people say**

- A pilgrim went into the lake last year and came out on the other side of it. That's the story, anyway.
- The magistrate is a yuan-ti. The Order made her magistrate anyway. Nobody knows why.
- Pilgrims coming back from the Luminara Gate don't talk about what they saw.

entities.name: Dawnward Healer
entities.summary:
*A missionary healer of the [Celestial Order](/player/e/FAC-001), carrying mercy and the law together.*

> White robes, a satchel of bandages and a sun-disc that glows when they pray.

**What you know**

- The Order's missionary healers, who travel with its knights.
- They heal anyone, then preach to them.

**What people say**

- They will heal you whether you want it or not.
- Their mercy has limits, and the limits are the law.

entities.name: Deep Gnomes
entities.summary:
*Small, stony people of the deep places, who trust rock more than anyone who lives above it.*

Deep gnomes live under the mountains of the [Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003), beneath the [Anvil of Dominion](/player/e/LOC-047), and in the old mines of the [Hollow Marches](/player/e/REG-001). The Consortium hires them to find what's buried. They usually find more than they're paid for.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) deep gnomes live along the edges of the under-roads, and they're the only people who travel them by choice. They know the roads better than anyone, and won't go past certain doors.

**Strengths and flaws.** Hard to see and harder to surprise underground. Wary of the open sky and of strangers.

**Culture.** Small, careful clans, trading in stone and silence.

**Common names.** Beldin, Durra, Fenn, Isolde, Kurn, Murr, Senna, Thaelris

**At the table.** Use the deep gnome rules.

entities.name: Deepcall
entities.summary:
*A vault deep under the centre of [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301), where the under-roads meet.*

Deepcall lies deep under the centre of Kaelmar, where the under-roads meet. [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302)'s catalogue says it holds the web itself, the roads through the between.

**What people say**

- You can hear it from the under-roads, calling.
- Root-road riders say they pass close to it, in the between.

entities.name: Dragonborn
entities.summary:
*Proud people with dragons' blood and dragons' breath, and the scales to prove it.*

Dragonborn clans live in the [Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003) and the [Radiant Ascendancy](/player/e/REG-002), where they're prized as soldiers and knights. Some count themselves among the Reptilians; most would rather you didn't. Their clan histories go back further than anyone's, and they don't agree with each other.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) dragonborn are mostly sailors and mercenaries off the [Aetheris](/player/e/CON-001) ships, and they turn heads in [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302)'s streets.

**Strengths and flaws.** Strong, fierce, and a breath that can clear a room. Proud to a fault.

**Culture.** Clan honour above all. Every dragonborn knows their clan's name, and most have a story about it.

**Common names.** Arjhan, Balasar, Kava, Medrash, Nala, Rhogar, Sora, Torinn

**At the table.** Use the dragonborn rules.

entities.name: Dread-feyr
entities.summary:
*A nightmare given a body: a mass of fear that wears the shape of what you dread most.*

> At first, a heap of something dark and wet. Then it stands up, and it is exactly the thing you were afraid of as a child.

**Where.** The [Black Horizon](/player/e/ETH-507).

**What you know**

- Things made of fear, at the edge of the Black Horizon.
- They grow from travellers' nightmares.

**What people say**

- Don't sleep near the Horizon.
- Kill one and you'll never have that nightmare again. You'll have a new one.

entities.name: Drennal "the Barnacled Knight"
entities.summary:
*A tortle knight the ocean will not release.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tortle | Paladin | He/him | A wreck off the [Eternal Veil](/player/e/REG-005) |

**Looks.** A tortle in rusted plate, his shell crusted with barnacles and weed, smelling always of low tide.

**Manner.** Weary, dutiful and kind to children.

**Who they are**

- A knight of the [Drowned Saints](/player/e/CLT-003).

**What people say**

- Drennal serves because the ocean will not release him.

entities.name: Driftholm
entities.summary:
*A town on a floating island, moored to the mountains by chains, which goes wherever the storms take it when the chains break.*

> The island hangs in the air above the peaks, held down by four great chains, and the town on top of it is all rope bridges, wind-chimes and laundry flapping sideways. Lightning walks around the edges of the sky. A ladder of iron rungs runs up the nearest chain, and somebody at the top is waving you on.

**What you know**

- A town on a floating island in the [Fractured Nexus](/player/e/REG-004), chained to the mountains.
- When a chain breaks, the town drifts until it's caught again. It's been as far as the Marches.
- Consortium researchers study the island's stone. The townsfolk sell them tea.
- [Anchor-Master Wenna Gale](/player/e/NPC-368) keeps the chains.

**Places in the town**

| Place | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| The Four Chains | Each as thick as a house, anchored in the rock below. One is new, and the town still argues about the old one. |
| The Chime Market | A market where every stall has wind-chimes, so you can find it in a storm. |
| The Edge | The rim of the island, with a rope rail. Children dare each other to lean out. |

**Getting around.** [Zepharyos](/player/e/SET-012) is about two days away, by chain-ladder and mountain road, or a day if the island has drifted the right way.

**What people say**

- The island drifted once, before the Cycle broke, and came back with a different name. Nobody remembers the old one.
- Wenna Gale can call the wind. That's why she keeps the chains.
- Somebody keeps cutting the chains, one link at a time.

entities.name: Driftwhale
entities.summary:
*A vast, gentle beast that swims the silver between the wreck-islands of the Fields.*

> Something the size of a ship turns slowly over the wreckage, its belly lit like a lantern, and sings a long low note that you feel in your teeth.

**Where.** The [Fields of Lost Realities](/player/e/ETH-502).

**What you know**

- Great beasts that swim between the islands of the Fields.
- Salvagers follow them, because they always find the way out.

**What people say**

- Driftwhales sing the way home.
- Some of the Fields' salvagers live on their backs.

entities.name: Drowned Saint
entities.summary:
*A saint of the drowned, who came back from the sea wrong.*

> A figure in rotted vestments, wet and dripping, with the sea in its eyes.

**What you know**

- The Drowned Saints' holy ones, who drowned and returned.

**What people say**

- If you look at one too long, you start to drown on dry land.

entities.name: Duergar
entities.summary:
*Grey dwarves of the deep forges, hard as their iron and twice as stubborn.*

Duergar hold the deepest forges under the [Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003), and the Legion's best weapons come out of their hands. They have little love for their surface cousins, and their records disagree with everyone's.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) duergar live under the northern highlands, below the dwarf holds, and say they were Kaelith's ironworkers. Nobody's checked.

**Strengths and flaws.** Tough, strong, and able to grow or vanish at will. Grim, and slow to forgive.

**Culture.** Forge-clans, hard bargains, and long grudges kept in iron ledgers.

**Common names.** Brakka, Duren, Gorm, Hilde, Korra, Morn, Thrain, Vessa

**At the table.** Use the duergar rules.

entities.name: Dwarves
entities.summary:
*Stoneborn mountain folk: enduring, stubborn and keepers of records.*

Dwarves are enduring warriors and master crafters, and they keep records of everything. Their records do not always agree with the world. In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301), dwarves were Kaelith's masons, and they still hold the northern highlands.

**Strengths and flaws.** Enduring warriors and master crafters. Stubborn.

**Culture.** Engineering, stonecraft and record-keeping.

**Common names.** Brom, Dara, Harn, Kella, Orra, Vara, Venn, Yorr

**At the table.** Use the dwarf rules.

entities.name: Earth Genasi
entities.summary:
*People with the earth in them: skin like stone, patience like a mountain, and a grip nobody breaks.*

Earth genasi are born in quarries, caves and battlefields, and [Aetheris](/player/e/CON-001) has plenty of all three. They're common in the [Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003), where the Legion's champions are as often stone as flesh, and in the Scar, where the ground itself is broken.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) earth genasi are born in the [Eastern Mountains](/player/e/REG-302) and under the highlands, and the [Wrights](/player/e/FAC-308) hire them to move what nothing else can.

**Strengths and flaws.** Unshakeable and very hard to move. Slow to start, slower to stop.

**Culture.** Patient, practical, and not easily impressed.

**Common names.** Basalt, Dorra, Garnet, Hollis, Krag, Mica, Ronan, Slate

**At the table.** Use the earth genasi rules.

entities.name: Echo
entities.summary:
*A copy of someone who passed through the Verge, left behind and trying to finish their life.*

> A stranger who looks exactly like someone you know, and who knows things only they would know, except the last few years.

**Where.** The [Hollow Verge](/player/e/ETH-501).

**What you know**

- Copies left behind in the Verge by people who passed through.
- They believe they're the real one.

**What people say**

- If you meet yourself in the Verge, be kind. It's having a worse day than you are.
- Some echoes try to get back to the world. Some make it.

entities.name: Echoborn
entities.summary:
*Seekers of whatever lies beyond the [Ethereal Realm](/player/e/CON-501).*

**What they want.** To find out what lies beyond the realm, and to get there.

**Who they are.** [Elyndria the Echo](/player/e/NPC-072) believes the realm is just one more layer of control, and that there's a way out of it.

**Where.** [The Observatory of the Last Question](/player/e/LOC-508), at the [Black Horizon](/player/e/ETH-507).

**What people say**

- The Echoborn think everyone else is in a cage. Some of them are very convincing.

entities.name: Edda Halvor
entities.summary:
*Brenna Halvor's younger sister, who builds Ashvale's walkers.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Human | Artificer | She/her | Ashvale |

**Looks.** A wiry young woman with oil to the elbows and a half-built walker following her like a dog.

**Manner.** Impatient, inventive and fiercely loyal to her sister.

**Who they are**

- A walker-builder of [The Wrights](/player/e/FAC-308) in [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301).
- Sister to [Chief Wright Brenna Halvor](/player/e/NPC-306).

**What people say**

- Her walkers can carry a cart up the west road.
- She has been inside the old waygate further than she admits.

entities.name: Eladrin
entities.summary:
*Elves whose moods turn with the seasons, and who sometimes forget which world they're standing in.*

Eladrin are rare in [Aetheris](/player/e/CON-001) and tend to turn up with no past, as if the Cycle forgot to finish them. They change with the seasons: warm in summer, grieving in autumn, cold in winter. Many have found a home with the Wildborn, and a few in stranger company.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) eladrin are almost unknown. The [Spore Circle](/player/e/FAC-302)'s eldest say the [Bloom](/player/e/COS-301) has a season they don't have a name for, and look at eladrin oddly.

**Strengths and flaws.** Fey-step and fey charm. Changeable, and hard for others to keep up with.

**Culture.** No homeland they can name. Many keep a token from each season of their lives.

**Common names.** Aerith, Faen, Ilsevel, Lirael, Naivara, Sylas, Thaelon, Vaelis

**At the table.** Use the eladrin rules.

entities.name: Elder Aelis Thornweave
entities.summary:
*[Highbough](/player/e/SET-023)'s eladrin elder, whose temper follows the seasons and whose word is law in the canopy.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Eladrin | Warrior | They/them | Highbough |

**Looks.** A tall eladrin whose hair turns with the seasons, green, gold, rust and white, and whose skin is patterned like bark.

**Manner.** Warm in summer, grieving in autumn, cold in winter, and wild in spring.

**Who they are**

- Elder of Highbough, among the [Wildborn Clans](/player/e/FAC-005).
- Decides who is let up the rope.

**What people say**

- In winter, Aelis lets nobody up. In spring, everyone.
- They fought in the [Border Years](/player/e/HIS-012), and won't say on which side.

entities.name: Elder Marrow "the Writeless Prophet"
entities.summary:
*A mute kenku seer whose writing in the sand survives the tide.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Kenku | Monk | They/them | A fishing village on the dusk coast |

**Looks.** An old grey kenku with a crooked beak, always carrying a stick for writing in the sand.

**Manner.** Mute, by vow. Answers with what they write, and sometimes with a borrowed sound: waves, gulls, a bell.

**Who they are**

- A mute seer of the [Drowned Saints](/player/e/CLT-003).

**What people say**

- What Elder Marrow writes in the sand survives the tide.

entities.name: Elder Mott Greyfold
entities.summary:
*[Greyfold](/player/e/SET-322)'s old dwarf priest of [Solenne](/player/e/DEI-901), who keeps the village shrine and its records.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dwarf | Cleric | He/him | Greyfold |

**Looks.** A white-bearded dwarf in a faded sun-yellow stole, with spectacles and a ledger of births and deaths.

**Manner.** Kind, fussy and precise about dates.

**Who they are**

- Elder and shrine-keeper of Greyfold.
- Keeps a record of every birth and death in the village.

**What people say**

- His records go back further than [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301)'s.
- Greyfold has more children born with light under their skin than anywhere else.

entities.name: Elder Myrris Thornveil
entities.summary:
*An ancient firbolg druid who remembers the world before the wars.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Firbolg | Shaman | She/her | The [Rootspire](/player/e/SET-014), the Verdant Rebirth |

**Looks.** An enormous, stooped firbolg with blue-grey skin and a beard of hanging lichen, leaning on a staff that has started to sprout.

**Manner.** Slow, kind and very old. Calls everyone "sapling".

**Who they are**

- An ancient druid and elder of the [Wildborn Clans](/player/e/FAC-005), in [The Verdant Rebirth](/player/e/REG-006).

**What people say**

- Thornveil remembers the world before the wars.
- She remembers it differently every time she tells it.

entities.name: Elder Saba Grane
entities.summary:
*Maro Grane's elder sister, and the Collective's eldest of the cycles.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Orc | Paladin | She/her | The ash barrens |

**Looks.** A broad grey-green orc with glyph-cuts healed silver on both arms, and a Root Text bound in hide at her hip.

**Manner.** Steady, warm and immovable. The calm to her brother's fire.

**Who they are**

- An elder of the cycles of [The Convergence Collective](/player/e/FAC-304).
- Sister to [Maro Grane](/player/e/NPC-310).

**What people say**

- Nobody joins the Collective without sitting with Saba first.
- She turns away more converts than she accepts.

entities.name: Elder Sorrel
entities.summary:
*An elf of the Spore Circle who saw the Shrouding, and wants every Kaelith work burned.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Elf | Shaman | She/her | Thornhaven, the [Eastern Deepwood](/player/e/REG-301) |

**Looks.** An elf of about 320, small and brown-skinned, with grey hair cropped short and a gourd-lamp glowing green at her belt.

**Manner.** Sharp, unforgiving and fond of silence.

**Who they are**

- Leader of the Eastern Tendril of [The Spore Circle](/player/e/FAC-302), at [Thornhaven](/player/e/LOC-308).
- Saw the Shrouding as a child.

**What people say**

- She wants every piece of Kaelith work burned.
- She will never forgive what happened.

entities.name: Elder Tamsin Rook
entities.summary:
*An elder of the Spore Circle who rarely speaks and is seldom seen.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Elf | Shaman | She/her | The [Central Bloom Country](/player/e/REG-303) |

**Looks.** A very old elf with eyes clouded white with fine crystals, and branching lines covering both arms.

**Manner.** Slow, distant, and often answering a question nobody asked.
