entities.summary:
*A [Shadow Pact](/player/e/FAC-004) information broker nobody can describe the same way twice.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Reptilian (lizardfolk) | Silent Blade | They/them | [Noctis](/player/e/SET-013), the [Eternal Veil](/player/e/REG-005) |

**Looks.** A grey-scaled lizardfolk in a grey cloak. Witnesses disagree on height, eye colour and how many teeth showed.

**Manner.** Easy, funny and forgettable. Never sits with their back to a door.

**Who they are**

- A Shadow Pact agent in [The Hollow Marches](/player/e/REG-001).
- Trades in information.

**What people say**

- Nobody agrees on what Vess looks like.
- Vess never sits with their back to a door.
- Someone swears they saw Vess in two places at once.

entities.name: Vexis "the Infernal Architect"
entities.summary:
*A kobold builder who makes fire permanent, and mostly works for pay.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Kobold | Artificer | They/them | The [Anvil of Dominion](/player/e/LOC-047), the [Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003) |

**Looks.** A rust-red kobold in a leather apron, goggles and singed whiskers, carrying a wand made of furnace parts.

**Manner.** Practical, chatty and bored by sermons.

**Who they are**

- A builder of the [Ashen Covenant](/player/e/CLT-001). Not a zealot.

**What people say**

- Vexis makes fire permanent.
- Vexis only joined because the Covenant pays.

entities.name: Veyra the Unchained
entities.summary:
*A former champion of the [Celestial Order](/player/e/FAC-001) who broke her oath, and her fate with it.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Aasimar | Warrior | She/her | [Empyrean Spire](/player/e/SET-010), the [Radiant Ascendancy](/player/e/REG-002) |

**Looks.** An aasimar whose inner light has gone wild and flickering, wearing broken Order plate and chains she snapped herself.

**Manner.** Fierce, funny and quick to anger at any mention of oaths.

**Who they are**

- Once a champion of the Celestial Order.
- Broke her oath, and says she broke her fate along with it.

**What people say**

- The Order would very much like her back, in chains.
- Never swear an oath in front of her.

entities.name: Vhalek "the Silent Watcher"
entities.summary:
*A githzerai who never speaks or acts. His eyes show the end of all things.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Githzerai | Monk | He/him | Unknown |

**Looks.** A githzerai in a plain grey robe who sits perfectly still, eyes open, for days at a time.

**Manner.** He never speaks or acts.

**Who they are**

- A figure of the [Black Sun](/player/e/CLT-002).

**What people say**

- Vhalek never speaks or acts.
- Meet his eyes and you will see the end of all things.

entities.name: Void Feeder
entities.summary:
*A creature of the Rift that feeds on strength itself.*

> Something like a spider made of absence, stepping out of nowhere.

**What you know**

- Creatures that come up out of the Rift.

**What people say**

- Its bite leaves you weaker, and it does not wear off quickly.

entities.name: Walker
entities.summary:
*A Kaelith work-construct that walks on its own, or one the [Wrights](/player/e/FAC-308) have built new.*

> A tall frame of brass and old wood, stepping carefully on long legs.

**What you know**

- Kaelith built walkers to carry and work.
- [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301)'s Wrights build new ones.

**What people say**

- Old walkers still wander the ruins, doing jobs nobody gave them.

entities.name: War-vessel
entities.summary:
*A walking hill of hide and iron, shaped by the minds inside it.*

> A hill of hide and iron with a dais in its back, reshaping itself to fit the ground.

**What you know**

- Great war-constructs of Kaelith.
- They take only the shapes all the minds inside agree on.

**What people say**

- The Collective's Warband rides lesser ones.
- A whole war-vessel has not moved in three hundred years.

entities.name: Warden Brin Oakhallow
entities.summary:
*[Oakhallow](/player/e/SET-324)'s forest warden, a shifter who knows every tree for a day's walk.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shifter | Ranger | They/them | Oakhallow |

**Looks.** A lean shifter with tufted ears, bark-brown skin and a longbow strung with gut.

**Manner.** Quiet, dry and quick to laugh at outsiders.

**Who they are**

- Warden and headperson of the woodland village of Oakhallow.

**What people say**

- Brin can track a deer through the [Bloom](/player/e/COS-301) country.
- They do not trust the [Spore Circle](/player/e/FAC-302)'s scouts in their woods.

entities.name: Warforged
entities.summary:
*Made people of iron and old work: leftovers of erased worlds in [Aetheris](/player/e/CON-001), and Kaelith's sleeping vessels in [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301).*

Warforged in Aetheris are leftovers of worlds that don't exist any more. When the Cycle broke, a few dozen of them were found standing on battlefields and in ruins, built for wars nobody remembers, and they've had to work out who to be since. Some serve the factions. Most just want to know who made them.

In Kaelmar, a warforged would be one of Kaelith's guardians or vessels, woken. As far as anyone knows, none has woken yet, so a warforged walking in Kaelmar would be the first, and everyone from [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302) to the [Ascendancy](/player/e/FAC-305) would want to know who woke them.

**Strengths and flaws.** Tireless and hard to hurt. Uncertain of their own past, and other people's reactions.

**Culture.** No culture but what they've chosen, and a careful way with words.

**Common names.** Anvil, Bastion, Echo, Lantern, Sentinel, Seraphis, Tally, Vessel

**At the table.** Use the warforged rules.

entities.name: Warlord Garron Kael
entities.summary:
*The hobgoblin warlord who rules the [Crimson Legion](/player/e/FAC-002) from the battlefield.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hobgoblin | Warrior | He/him | [Varkhaal](/player/e/SET-011), the Tyrant's Dominion |

**Looks.** A heavy-set hobgoblin with a grey-streaked crest of hair and a jaw full of gold teeth, each one taken from a rival.

**Manner.** Jovial, crude and suddenly, terrifyingly violent. Never raises his voice before he raises his fist.

**Who they are**

- Leader of the Crimson Legion, the faction that rules [The Tyrant's Dominion](/player/e/REG-003).
- Rules from the battlefield, not a throne.

**What people say**

- The Warlord holds the Legion through sheer brutality.
- Kael's heir, [Darion Kael](/player/e/NPC-033), does not share the Warlord's taste for war.
- Every gold tooth has a name, and he will tell you all of them.

entities.name: Warrior
entities.summary:
*The Iron Vanguard: heavy armour, blocks, parries and brute force.*

Warriors are the Iron Vanguard. They fight in heavy armour and win with blocks, parries and brute force. Every army, mercenary company and caravan guard in the world is built around them.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301), warriors guard [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302)'s expeditions, ride in the [Convergence Collective](/player/e/FAC-304)'s Warband, or sell their swords to the mercenary companies of the eastern mountains.

**At the table.** A fighter, usually a Champion or a Battle Master.

entities.name: Watchbarrow
entities.summary:
*A vault in the western hills, said to be where Kaelith's guardians rest.*

Watchbarrow lies in the western hills, not far from [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301)'s villages. [Kaelholm](/player/e/SET-302)'s catalogue calls it the vault of the long watch, where Kaelith's guardians rest between their watches.

**What people say**

- The hill folk leave food at its barrow. It's always gone in the morning.
- Something in there is still keeping watch.

entities.name: Water Genasi
entities.summary:
*People with the sea in their blood, calm as still water until they aren't.*

Water genasi are born near the sea, and since [Maruun](/player/e/DEI-907) fell, more are born each year along the dusk coast and on the [Black Tides](/player/e/LOC-902) themselves. Sailors count one in a crew as a blessing. The [Drowned Saints](/player/e/CLT-003) count them as proof.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) water genasi are born along the southern fens and lakes, and the lizardfolk of the fens treat them as kin.

**Strengths and flaws.** At home in the water, and hard to drown. Moody as the tide.

**Culture.** Coast and river folk, sailors, and a deep pull towards the sea.

**Common names.** Althisa, Brine, Coral, Ilythis, Marin, Nerys, Pearl, Tide

**At the table.** Use the water genasi rules.

entities.name: Weft-mangler
entities.summary:
*A many-armed horror that comes out of nowhere and cuts.*

> Nothing, and then six clawed arms and a body like a peeled shadow, already moving, already cutting.

**Where.** The [Loom of Eternity](/player/e/ETH-505).

**What you know**

- Ambush predators of the Loom, all arms and claws.
- They come out of shadow you didn't notice.

**What people say**

- If you see one, it's already too late. If you see two, run.

entities.name: Well-Warden Ysolde Varn
entities.summary:
*[Archwell](/player/e/SET-015)'s well-keeper, a sea elf who came up a well and never went back.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sea elf | Mage | She/her | Archwell |

**Looks.** A tall, grey-skinned sea elf with dark wet-looking hair that never quite dries, and a bronze key on a chain.

**Manner.** Calm, dry-humoured and very hard to surprise.

**Who they are**

- Warden of the well at Archwell, and the village's headwoman.
- Says she came up the well herself, years ago, and stayed because the bread was good.

**What people say**

- She can tell where the water came from by the taste.
- She keeps a list of everything the well has brought up. It's long.

entities.name: Wick
entities.summary:
*The Eastern Tendril scout who carries the green gourd-lamp to the edge of [Ashvale](/player/e/SET-301).*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Kenku | Ranger | He/him | Thornhaven |

**Looks.** A black-feathered kenku with a green gourd-lamp hung from his staff, and burn marks along his sleeves.

**Manner.** Silent, watchful, and speaking only in borrowed sounds.

**Who they are**

- A scout of the Eastern Tendril of [The Spore Circle](/player/e/FAC-302), from [Thornhaven](/player/e/LOC-308).
- Speaks only in sounds he has heard others make.

**What people say**

- The green lamp at Ashvale's treeline is his.
- He watches Ashvale for [Elder Sorrel](/player/e/NPC-307), and nobody knows what he reports.

entities.name: Wildborn Clans
entities.summary:
*The clans of the Verdant Rebirth: civilisation is a disease, and the forest is the cure.*

**What they want.** Cities swallowed by forest. No kings, weaker magic, and the law of the wild.

**What they promise.** A world that can go on living.

**How they work.** Beast hunters, shamans, primal spirits, and living constructs of root and bone. Each clan governs itself; the elders meet at the Den of Elders when it matters.

**Who leads.** [High Shaman Raethan "Stormcaller"](/player/e/NPC-054), with [Elder Myrris Thornveil](/player/e/NPC-060).

**Where.** The [The Verdant Rebirth](/player/e/REG-006), around [The Rootspire](/player/e/SET-014). Its chief fortress is the [Verdant Crown](/player/e/LOC-055).

**Their sign.** A green crown of roots.

**Who opposes them.** The [Celestial Order](/player/e/FAC-001), which hunts them; the [Arcane Consortium](/player/e/FAC-003), which they think is ruining the world; and the [Crimson Legion](/player/e/FAC-002), across the [Bloodfields](/player/e/LOC-045).

**Belonging.** A clan adopts you, or it doesn't. Members swear to [Orrowen](/player/e/DEI-905) and to their clan, and they're expected to give back to the land what they take from it.

**What people say**

- The Wildborn would sacrifice a city to save a tree.
- The Thornward Grove takes in anyone fleeing the Order. Nobody asks how the Order doesn't know.
- There are no roads in the Verdant Rebirth. The Wildborn like it that way.

entities.name: Wither's Hollow
entities.summary:
*A dead forest in endless mist, whose paths shift once you've walked past them.*

> The trees are grey and dead, and the mist never lifts. The path ahead looks clear. You walk ten steps, look back, and the path behind you is gone, and a different one is there instead. Somewhere in the mist, something is breathing.

**What you know**

- A dead, mist-bound forest in the [Hollow Marches](/player/e/REG-001).
- Its paths shift behind travellers.
- [Mother Thorn](/player/e/NPC-009) knows its trails better than anyone.

**Getting around**

| From Wither's Hollow to | Time | How safe |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The [Bloodmarked Fields](/player/e/LOC-002) | 1 day | Dangerous |
| The Rift | Half a day | Openly hostile |

**What people say**

- The paths in Wither's Hollow move once you've walked past them.
- One path never moves, and nobody who follows it comes back the same.
- The forest knows who you are.

entities.name: Worm-speaker
entities.summary:
*Worm-headed folk who came in from beyond the Horizon and want to take others back with them.*

> People-shaped figures in grey robes, whose heads are worms, a ring of tiny teeth where a face should be. They speak very politely.

**Where.** The [Black Horizon](/player/e/ETH-507).

**What you know**

- Folk from beyond the Black Horizon, who live at its edge.
- They want to bring others back with them.

**What people say**

- They'll offer you a way out of the realm. It isn't one.
- The [Echoborn](/player/e/FAC-505) trade with them. Elyndria says that's fine.

entities.name: Wreck-eel
entities.summary:
*A long-jawed eel that hunts through the drifting wreckage of the Fields.*

> A silver eel as long as a wagon, eyeless, sliding through a broken cathedral window with its jaw hanging open.

**Where.** The [Fields of Lost Realities](/player/e/ETH-502).

**What you know**

- Predators of the Fields' wreckage.
- They hunt by sound.

**What people say**

- Never shout in the Fields.
- Wreck-eel teeth sell for good money at the Asylum.

entities.name: Wrong Distance
entities.summary:
*Past the edge of the realm, distance and time stop agreeing.*

> The tower ahead gets further away as you walk toward it. Then you turn around, and it's behind you.

**Where.** The [Black Horizon](/player/e/ETH-507).

**What you know**

- At the Black Horizon, a step can take a year and a day's walk a minute.

**What people say**

- Bring a rope, and tie everyone to it.
- [Sylas Vaerin](/player/e/NPC-064) says he's mapped it. His map changes every time you look.

entities.name: Yuan-ti
entities.summary:
*Serpent-folk with cold blood, sharp minds and a reputation they've mostly earned.*

Yuan-ti live along the dusk coast of the [Eternal Veil](/player/e/REG-005) and in the old ruins of the [Radiant Ascendancy](/player/e/REG-002), and they're distrusted almost everywhere. Some deserve it. Most are just very good at business, which isn't the same thing.

In [Kaelmar](/player/e/CON-301) yuan-ti are almost unknown, and the few who have crossed keep their distance from the lizardfolk of the fens, who don't like them.

**Strengths and flaws.** Resistant to poison and magic. Cold, and hard to trust.

**Culture.** Old families, older grudges, and a long view of everything.

**Common names.** Asha, Riven, Selka, Ssera, Tazzen, Vashti, Xaliss, Zehra

**At the table.** Use the yuan-ti rules.

entities.name: Yulrath "the Warhound"
entities.summary:
*The bugbear berserker the Company unleashes when it wants terror.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bugbear | Warrior | She/her | The Bloodfang Pit, the [Verdant Rebirth](/player/e/REG-006) |

**Looks.** A huge bugbear in a spiked iron collar, with a chain hanging from it that nobody ever holds.

**Manner.** Calm and sleepy, until she is let loose.

**Who they are**

- A berserker of the [Bloodbound Company](/player/e/CLT-004).

**What people say**

- The Company lets Yulrath off the leash when it wants terror.

entities.name: Yvara Ashborn
entities.summary:
*A fire genasi warrior born under an eclipse.*

| People | Calling | Pronouns | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fire Genasi | Monk | She/her | Born under an eclipse in the [Ravaged Pass](/player/e/LOC-057) |

**Looks.** A fire genasi with charcoal skin cracked with glowing seams, who fights barefoot and leaves scorched footprints.

**Manner.** Intense and sincere. Has never told a lie and does not understand why people do.

**Who they are**

- A fire-wielding warrior of the [Wildborn Clans](/player/e/FAC-005), in [The Verdant Rebirth](/player/e/REG-006).

**What people say**

- Yvara was born under an eclipse.
- The [Black Sun](/player/e/CLT-002) cult wants her very badly.

entities.name: Zepharyos
entities.summary:
*The [Arcane Consortium](/player/e/FAC-003)'s City of the Unbound, drifting among the clouds.*

> The city is not on the ground. It is islands of rock and tower drifting in the clouds, joined by bridges that are not always there. Some streets run sideways. One district is upside down, and the people in it seem not to mind. Lightning flickers between the spires and nobody looks up. The air tastes of metal and burnt paper.

**What you know**

- The capital of the [Fractured Nexus](/player/e/REG-004), and the seat of the Arcane Consortium. Called the City of the Unbound.
- The council sits in the Nexus Spire. The Consortium's chief fortress, the [Nexus Collegium](/player/e/LOC-048), stands nearby.
- Magic here is limitless and unstable. Floating islands and shifting time are normal.

**Places in town**

| Place | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| The Nexus Spire | Where the Consortium's council sits, at the one point the whole city turns around. |
| The Nexus Collegium | The Consortium's chief fortress and greatest school. |
| The Drift | Districts on floating islands that rearrange every few nights. Maps sell out daily, and are wrong by evening. |
| The Spans | Bridges of light between the islands. Mostly reliable. |
| The Quodlibet | The great market, named for the old scholars' word for an open debate. Spell components, wands and things with no names, sold by the ounce. Some arrive before they are ordered. |
| [Ithiel](/player/e/DEI-903)'s Lens | The Many-Eyed's temple and observatory: knowledge, magic and the stars, watched through a thousand lenses. |
| The Antipodes | A district that flipped in some old experiment and stayed that way. Its people do not see the problem. |
| The Keel | The one inn that never moves. Nobody knows how. |

**Who you'll meet**

- [Archmagister Veylan Orithis](/player/e/NPC-034), at the Nexus Spire or the Collegium.
- [Archivist Lissara Wynne](/player/e/NPC-035), [Magister Celith Varis](/player/e/NPC-038), [Sorcerer-King Jorvas Myrr](/player/e/NPC-037), [Pyromancer Elaris Duskbane](/player/e/NPC-040) and [Master Talen Voros](/player/e/NPC-042).
- Students from every people and every dominion.

**Getting around**

| From Zepharyos to | Time | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Hollow Refuge](/player/e/SET-001) | About two weeks | A week to the border, a week through storm country. |
| The [Echoing Halls](/player/e/LOC-050) and the [Rift of Unmaking](/player/e/LOC-049) | Elsewhere in the Fractured Nexus | Neither is anywhere you want to be. |

**What people say**

- Half of Zepharyos floats because of something the Archmagister did by accident.
- If your island moves while you sleep, you pay rent in the new district.
- Some of the bridges lead somewhere other than the next island.
